name: qualified_namespaces
cpp: namespace a { int leaf(){return 1;} } namespace b { int leaf(){return 2;} } int caller(){return a::leaf()+b::leaf();}

name: overload_set
cpp: int pick(int x){return x;} double pick(double x){return x;} int caller(){return pick(1);} double caller_double(){return pick(1.0);}

name: typed_receivers
cpp: struct A { int run(){return 1;} }; struct B { int run(){return 2;} }; int caller(A &a,B &b){return a.run()+b.run();}
purpose: C++ parameter types should select the correct method

name: qualified_miss
cpp: namespace actual { int leaf(){return 1;} } namespace foreign { int leaf(); } int caller(){return foreign::leaf();}
purpose: Explicit qualifier must not fall back to unrelated singleton

name: header_receiver
header: namespace external { struct B { int run(); }; }
cpp:
#include "api.hpp"
struct A { int run(){return 1;} }; int caller(external::B &b){return b.run();}
purpose: Single-file singleton must not contradict a receiver declared in a header

name: template_identity
cpp: template<class T> T identity(T x){return x;} int caller(){return identity<int>(1);}

name: qualified_member_templates
cpp: namespace n { template<class T> T identity(T x){return x;} } struct A { template<class T> T apply(T x){return x;} }; int caller(A &a){return n::identity<int>(1)+a.apply<int>(2);}
purpose: Qualified and member template call syntax coverage

name: custom_callback
cpp: void callback(){} void invoke(void (*f)()){f();} void caller(){invoke(callback);}
purpose: Callback values and indirect call targets remain distinct

name: function_pointer_shadow
purpose: A function-pointer parameter shadows a same-name global function

name: macro_expansion
cpp:
#define RUN(f) f()
void callback(){} void caller(){RUN(callback);}
purpose: Macro call evidence differs from expanded callee

name: constructor
cpp: struct A { A(){} }; A caller(){return A();}
purpose: Construction has a separate relation and denominator
